title: I made a site to easily upload, share, and play your web-based games
author: RTSx1

comments.author: RTSx1
comments.body:
Hey all, I've been playing around a with making web-based games with AI lately and I found it frustrating to have to set up a whole deployment to share a link to my friends. So i made a free site where you can just drag and drop and immediately get a link to play your games. Let me know what you think!

https://www.sandboxed.games/

replies.author: Old_Ktulu
replies.body: What do you offer that itch.io doesn't already?

replies.author: RTSx1
replies.body: Me personally, sometimes I like to drag and drop and immediately get a link. Like Streamable vs YouTube
